title: Experimental-Bell source-family parity audit
auditBoundary: Static audit of the existing Whiskay tree and the previously recorded 17-family source inventory. The upstream repository could not be re-fetched in this environment; exact command-by-command equivalence is not claimed.

statusLegend.mapped_partial: A related target exists, but exact source commands and behavior still need comparison.
statusLegend.mapped_review: A related target exists and needs command/alias verification against the source.
statusLegend.gap_confirmed: No dedicated target module was found in the current Whiskay plugin tree.
statusLegend.source_module: Source is represented by a Whiskay module, but this is not proof of parity.
